name: plugin.youtube_transcript_fetcher
description: Extract transcripts and timed captions from YouTube video URLs or IDs via isolated subprocess JSON-RPC
author: Brain Harness Forge Engine

entrypoints.name: fetch_transcript
entrypoints.description: Extract full transcript or timed segments from a YouTube video URL or ID

parameters.name: video_url
parameters.description: Target YouTube video URL (watch, youtu.be, shorts, embed, live)

parameters.name: format
parameters.description: Output format: 'json' (timed segments list) or 'text' (concatenated plain text)

parameters.name: preserve_formatting
parameters.description: Whether to preserve HTML formatting in caption segments

entrypoints.name: get_transcript_text
entrypoints.description: Extract plain concatenated text of a YouTube video transcript without timestamp metadata

entrypoints.name: list_transcripts
entrypoints.description: List all available transcripts, languages, and translation tracks for a YouTube video

entrypoints.name: health
entrypoints.description: Check runtime health status and dependencies of the YouTube transcript fetcher plugin
